newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Elektrowatt to pay 8.0 Sfr dividend.
newsitem.headline: Elektrowatt to pay 8.0 Sfr dividend.

text.p: Elektrowatt AG, 44.9 percent owned by Swiss financial group CS Holding, said its board of directors would propose paying a dividend of eight Swiss francs, or 16 percent, for the abbreviated 1996 financial year.
The abbreviated year ran from February 1 through September 30, 1996, Elektrowatt said in a statement.
The financial year of the Elektrowatt holding company was changed to conform with that of the Elektrowatt group.
The dividend for the shortened 1996 year is unchanged from the dividend paid in the previous 12 month period, when Elektrowatt paid a dividend of 11.50 francs, or 23 percent.
The dividend will be proposed to the shareholders' meeting on February 19, 1997.
